$description: The label on a form control, including how it moves when it floats — one definition, so a combobox and a text input float theirs identically. The label on a form control. ONE group, not one per control: a label is the same decision whether it sits above a text input, beside a checkbox or over a range, and the moment there were two groups they drifted — the checkbox label lost the weight the input label had while both still claimed the same colour.
